description: Canonical vectors for the unified group-destination predicate, shared by three independent implementations: MCProxy is_group (src/mcapp/commands/parsing.py, the authoritative origin of the semantics), mc-chat is_group (meshcom_mock/commands.py) and the webapp isGroupDst (src/utils/callsignUtils.ts). Unified semantics (drift-resolution campaign 2026-07-27, webapp docs/code-simpl-v2.md): dst is a group iff it equals 'TEST' case-insensitively, OR it is a non-empty all-ASCII-digit string whose integer value is in 1..99999 (leading zeros allowed: '00232' is group 232). Everything else is NOT a group: empty, '*', 'Time', 'ALL' (broadcast-like dsts are OR'd in explicitly by call sites that want them, e.g. the blocklist gate), callsigns, signed/spaced/scientific numerics, via-routed strings (callers resolve the effective target BEFORE asking this predicate), and any non-ASCII digit. Non-ASCII digits are the trap this fixture exists to pin: Python str.isdigit() accepts '٣', '２' and '²' while JS /^\d+$/ rejects them all; int('٣') == 3 and int('１２３') == 123 (a naive backend accepts non-ASCII group ids the webapp rejects) and int('²') raises ValueError (a guard-less backend crashes -- mc-chat's pre-campaign is_group did exactly that). Backends therefore gate on dst.isascii() before isdigit(). SYNC RULE: canonical source is THIS file in MCProxy; parse-equal vendored copies live at mc-chat/tests/fixtures/group_dst_vectors.json and webapp/src/utils/__tests__/group_dst_vectors.json (Prettier may reformat the webapp copy; only content drift is a failure). Every repo replays every vector against its own implementation, and sibling drift-checks self-skip when the sibling checkout is absent. v2 pins that is_group() stays NUMERIC-ONLY: a '#'-prefixed destination is NOT a group. Hashtag classification lives in the sibling predicate is_hashtag() -- see hashtag_dst_vectors.json. Widening is_group() would have changed the meaning of a predicate mirrored in three repos; a sibling was chosen instead.
